title: Load old ticket rows into states that can't contradict themselves

cases.says: each consistent row becomes the record its status names, and writing it back gives the same row
a row missing the agent or resolution its status needs, or with an unknown status, is refused
code that builds an Assigned or Resolved directly, without its data, is refused by the record itself
a row whose status can't have an agent or a resolution, but has one, is refused rather than trimmed
a refused row's exception message names the row's id

origin.section: Give Each State Its Own Record, and an Order Without a Tracking Number Can't Be Shipped
